name: Leominster Recreation Summer Programs (Sunshine Bunch, Adventure Squad, Little Flamingos)
description_short: Leominster's town summer programs at Samoset School: Sunshine Bunch for ages 6 to 9 and Adventure Squad for ages 10 to 12 run full days with sports, games, building challenges and crafts, and Little Flamingos is a morning program for ages 4 and 5.
refund_policy_summary: Registrations are not refundable unless the department cancels the program; a $10 processing fee applies to any refund.
notes: Resident rates: Sunshine Bunch and Adventure Squad $120 for Week 1 and $140 a week after; Little Flamingos $100 and $120. Non residents may enroll if space permits. Adventure Squad normally meets at Barrett Park but moves to Samoset School for summer 2026 because of construction.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Summer brochure. All three run June 29 to July 31, 2026 (no program July 3) at Samoset School, 100 DeCicco Drive. Sunshine Bunch (ages 6 to 9) and Adventure Squad (ages 10 to 12), 9:00 am to 3:00 pm: Week 1 (Monday to Thursday) $120 resident, $140 non resident; Weeks 2 to 5 $140 resident, $160 non resident. Little Flamingos (ages 4 and 5), 9:00 am to 1:00 pm: Week 1 $100 resident, $120 non resident; Weeks 2 to 5 $120 resident, $140 non resident. Session prices are the non resident full day rates. Lunches not provided; nut free. Priority to residents; non residents allowed if space permits at $20 more. Financial assistance for Leominster residents only, apply by May 15, 2026. Registration began April 7.
ZIP looked up with the Census Bureau geocoder from the address on the camp's page (100 DECICCO DR, LEOMINSTER, MA, 01453)
